description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Close CRM Leads. Close has no native atomic upsert endpoint (unlike Salesforce's External-ID upsert or HubSpot's batch/upsert), so this emulates one via search-then-write: POST /data/search/ (Advanced Filtering) to find an existing Lead by dedupe_field, then PUT /lead/{id}/ or POST /lead/. NOT race-condition-safe under concurrent writers.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one Close Lead (upserted via dedupe_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key). No downstream data — the write side effect lands in Close CRM.

dedupe_field.label: Dedupe Field
dedupe_field.description: Close field used to search for an existing Lead (no native upsert — emulated via search-then-write; NOT race-condition-safe). One of 'email' (recommended), 'phone', 'name' (not guaranteed unique), or 'custom.cf_xxx'. MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → Close field. Values: 'name', 'contact_name', 'email', 'phone', or 'custom.cf_xxx'.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Close CRM Lead Upsert
